topic: Myth: A part-time job teaches more than a side hustle
caption:
A job teaches your teen to show up.
A side hustle teaches them to figure it out.
There's room for both, but only one of them starts with your teen making a decision instead of waiting for a manager to make it for them.
Give them a head start → hustleup.us
